name: mades/summer-craft-service-hub
description: The -=Summer Craft=- Service Hub: DB handler, logging, mail, HTTP client, files and other services

suggest.ext-dom: Required only by SummerCraft\Service\HtmlParser\DomHtmlParser — the default HtmlParser binding is SimpleHtmlDomParser, which needs no extension
suggest.ext-iconv: Preferred for recoding documents that declare a non-UTF-8 charset and for encoding non-ASCII mail headers; without it SimpleHtmlDom recodes through mbstring and EmailSender does its own Q encoding
